eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Lassen, CA; at 4:26 PM on AUG 16, 2021 Effective until 4:26 PM AUG 17, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
NEW EVACUATION WARNINGS HAVE BEEN ISSUED FOR 
-The area west of Richmond Rd and south of Hwy 36 from Thumper Hill east to N Weatherlow St and south to Gold Run Rd

-West of Richmond Rd from Gold Run Rd south to Childrens Rd but not including roads immediately adjacent to the Golf Course 

ALL PREVIOUSLY ISSUED EVACUATION WARNINGS AND ORDERS REMAIN IN PLACE

Go to community.zonehaven.com to find the status of your address


Safety Message: People under evacuation order should leave immediately.  Those under warning who require assistance and those with pets and livestock should leave now.  Use caution, drive with your headlights on and yield to emergency personnel. If you are in city limits and need assistance evacuating, call 530-260-6026 All others needing assistance should call dispatch at 530-257-6121. An Emergency Shelter is located at Lassen Community College in Susanville.  The Shelter number is (530) 250-9004.  Large animals can be taken to Lassen County Fairgrounds.  Deputies will be going door to door to make notifications.
